title: User can view AI QA Summary
description: As a quality leader, I want to view an AI-generated QA summary so that I can quickly understand the current quality posture without manually reviewing raw test data.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays an AI QA Summary section
AI summary includes a generated timestamp
AI summary includes an Overall Status section
AI summary includes Key Signals with core metrics (total tests, failed tests, release risk)
AI summary includes Risk Drivers section
AI summary includes Recommended Next Steps section
AI summary Release Risk Level is one of: low, medium, high, unknown
AI summary Release Recommendation is one of: safe_to_release, release_with_caution, do_not_release, unknown
AI summary does not display error or fallback placeholder text
